title: Bus Fleet Electrification Under Capital Cost and Scheduling Constraints: A Five-Agency Case Study
summary: As transit agencies consider bus fleet electrification, understanding the efficiency and cost of replacing diesel buses (DBs) with battery electric buses (BEBs) is critical. To evaluate this, this study applies a mixed-fleet optimization model, integrating scheduling, charging, and fleet composition decisions, across five agencies: Santa Monica's Big Blue Bus (BBB), the Chicago Transit Authority (CTA), Knoxville Area Transit (KAT), the Metropolitan Atlanta Rapid Transit Authority (MARTA), and Manhattan's Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA) bus service.
